cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I taught you how to choose a strong photograph. For the reunion poster: mine or Sam's?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sam's. Yours is a little blurred.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Very observant. Pity we haven't reached the lesson about supporting a colleague. Will you at least send mine first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send them together, the same size. No favorites.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've learned fairness from someone, then. Put mine above his; that's just the order I taught you to lay out a page.
